name: Sana
source:
A familiar that serves the Takachiho family. The personification of a two tailed white cat.
She has a docile and hesitant personality.
[url=/c60335]Kana's[/url] younger twin sister.
She used to serve [url=/c29754]Mao[/url] along with her sister, but now she serves the protagonist.
